heading_en: Approval of the Internal Ratings-Based Approach
summary_ja: 最終指定親会社が内部格付手法を用いるには金融庁長官の承認が必要であることを定める。
summary_en: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company that intends to use the internal ratings-based approach must obtain the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company that intends to use the internal ratings-based approach shall obtain the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency.
